title: Synthetic staffing minimums
content: Example policy: keep at least the configured minimum staff per shift; any schedule violating minimum coverage must be rejected.

title: Synthetic bed allocation rules
content: Example policy: only allocate a bed when capacity, bed type, staffing, and required equipment are available. This document is for software testing only.

title: Synthetic operating room scheduling rules
content: Example policy: no overlapping bookings in the same operating room; required role coverage must be present; emergency cases follow configured priority rules.
